address: Via Principal Marina, 16, Torre del Greco, 80059, Italy
bio: In an elegant setting facing the harbour and the sea, the dining room at this restaurant is a terrace with large picture windows boasting beautiful views that also include Capri. The sea takes pride of place on the menu, which features fresh fish and plenty of local produce in the cuisine served here. Don’t miss the raw fish options, which include a selection of oysters, tartares and ceviche. Our inspector particularly enjoyed the roll of sea bass stuffed with spinach, fior di latte, beurre blanc sauce, parsley oil and onions....
